about_the_game:
Backrooms Maze 2D throws you into the unsettling, yellow-lit halls of the Backrooms — endless, shifting corridors where escape is your only goal and danger lurks around every corner.
Each run generates a brand-new maze filled with eerie ambience, lurking entities, and a ticking sanity meter that forces you to think fast.

You can choose from four difficulty modes:

  • Easy – A calmer experience with slower enemies.

  • Normal – More challenge and faster chases.

  • Hard – Two relentless enemies hunting you.

  • Extreme – Five fast enemies for the ultimate survival test.

Your only tools are your sense of direction and your ability to outmaneuver the entities. Every choice you make matters — one wrong turn could lead straight into danger.

Features

  • Procedurally Generated Mazes – Every run feels fresh and unpredictable.

  • Multiple Difficulty Levels – From casual to near-impossible survival.

  • Sanity System – Stay on the move or risk losing control.

  • Retro Visual Style – Simple, pixel-inspired characters with basic animation.

  • AI Enemies – Enemies that roam, chase, and block your path.

  • Immersive Audio – Ambient hum, footsteps, and pause effects.

  • Settings Menu – Adjust brightness, master volume, and sound levels.

  • Multi-Language Support – Play in 25+ languages.

  • Quick Restart – Escape or get caught, then jump right back in.

💬 Join Our Community

Step inside the madness.
Join the official Insanity Studios Discord to connect with players, share feedback, and get early updates on our latest projects — including Backrooms Maze 2D and future horror titles.

👁️ Stay updated. Stay alert. Don’t trust the walls.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard sound card

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent

  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 750 or better)

  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard sound card

short_description: Backrooms Maze 2D is a tense survival maze game where you navigate shifting halls, evade relentless enemies, and race to the exit before your sanity drains away. Multiple difficulty levels, pixel art style, and eerie ambience keep you on edge every step of the way.
